description:
Orky Sector (Formally Looted Sector)

An orky starsector mod by Myco and Miko

Da Goffs are there to show all dat gitz who'z in charge!

WAAAGH!

Lazy Lib https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=5444.0

Arma Addon - Require 0.98/latest Arma Version/Orky Sector V0.71+

0.97 Version

Older 0.53 ver available on github, v0.60/61 may work with mod_info swap but not extensively tested back on 0.98[/url]

NOTE:

May 13 V 0.70, Adding the Goff Clan, clan focused on vicious close range combat, with the most ramming ship amongst all clans, and various tweaks to some existing hullmods and ships

Showcase of Ships and Weapons (To be updated with latest stuff)

Spoiler

The Great Collapse brought a new threat to the now isolated sector, bands of a previously unheard of, green-skinned Alien race begin to attack explorers and scavengers on the fringe rim of the sectors. These vicious creature seems to be at first nothing more than pirates in ramshackle ships that should not even be able to fly, but quickly proven to be much more sophisticated than they first seem.

In the years that follows, these aliens have made their name as ruthless pirates and scavengers, however, they were, until now, a curious nuisance to the major powers of the sector. Whilst ork pirate bands have gotten larger and even mingled with some human pirates, they never had the ability to take on a military fleet head on.

That is about to change.

Features

A Mod that brings Orks from the 40k universe into the Persean Sector in a semi vanilla-friendly manner. This mod adds currently adds five ork factions (Death Skull/Evil Sunz/Bad Moons/Blood Axes/Goffs) with a series of both looted vanilla vessels and more original constructions, together with a corresponding set of Orky Hullmods, Weapons and LPCs. Come with lunalib option to add some lower end ork ship to pirate fleets.

The faction focuses on generally ramshackle ships that favors high speed, brutal close quarter combat and burst damage. (As any Evil Sunz will tell ya, Going fast and Krumpin' stuff iz da best!), however, each clan will also have their own focus, from the more high tech approach of the flashy bad moons to the brutal goffs who fight up close and personal.

Many weapon and hullmods having powerful or strange effects but also potentially deadly downsides. The ork's strange psychic ability improves the combat ability and reliability of ships in great numbers, making their otherwise ramshackle warship more effective in great swarms.

There are also a simple system where you can beat up orks to obtain teef, allowing you to use them to exchange for various benefit from the ork clans, as well as a small quest, serving as basis for a longer chain we will eventually work on.

By now, the five main clan are ready (snake bite will play a smaller role, but will be featured), the next step will be expanded the campaign level systems such as teef shop and quests, but also touch up some of the older ships from the first few clans to make them a bit more unique.  :D

Some Design Thoughts
Turns out translating a bunch of mod gets one interested in trying to do some modding of their own. As a long time warhammer fan and ork player almost two decades, trying to bring the Orks to the Sector seems like a great excuse towards my limited spriting skills place to start!

There have been some excellent junker ship styles on the forums, and I thought to take a slightly different approach by focusing on the diversity of both fighting style and paintjob provided by the various Ork Clans in the setting, as a result this mod will be a bit more focused on bringing that aspect of Orky Kultur to the sector.

This is a Starsector mod first and foremost and I will not be strictly adhering to Battlefleet Gothic and 40k lore, and there will be some liberty in how I inject some proppa orkiness into the game, but I do hope you can find some good ol' orky fun within. This is our first starsector mod so any feedback and comment are appreciated as well.  :D

Some Previews of Orky Stuff in Action

discordPostHtml:
An orky starsector mod by Myco and Miko

A Mod that brings Orks from the 40k universe into the Persean Sector in a semi vanilla-friendly manner.

0.71c Update should be save compatible with 0.71

Lunalib now requried!

Download Link:
0.98 ver - 0.71c
https://github.com/MycophobiaSC/Looted_Sector/releases/download/v0.71c/Orky.Sector.-.En.v0.71c.zip

Arma Addon - 0.98 -v0.21
https://github.com/MycophobiaSC/Orky_Sector_Arma_Addon/releases/download/v0.21/Orky.Sector.-.Arma.Addon.0.21.zip

Older ver available on github if needed
Dependencies:
Lazy Lib
Magic Lib
Graphic Lib
Lunalib

Forum Post:
https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=29956.0

Features

A Mod that brings Orks from the 40k universe into the Persean Sector in a semi vanilla-friendly manner. This mod adds currently adds five ork factions (Death Skull/Evil Sunz/Bad Moons/Blood Axes/Goffs) with a series of both looted vanilla vessels and more original constructions, together with a corresponding set of Orky Hullmods, Weapons and LPCs.

The faction focuses on generally ramshackle ships that favors high speed, brutal close quarter combat and burst damage.

Many weapon and hullmods having powerful or strange effects but also potentially deadly downsides. The ork's strange psychic ability improves the combat ability and reliability of ships in great numbers, making their otherwise ramshackle warship more effective in great swarms.

There are also a simple system where you can beat up orks to obtain teef, allowing you to use them to exchange for various benefit from the ork clans, as well as a small quest, serving as basis for a longer chain we will eventually work on.

Some Design Thoughts
Turns out translating a bunch of mod gets one interested in trying to do some modding of their own. As a long time warhammer fan and ork player almost two decades, trying to bring the Orks to the Sector seems like a great excuse towards my limited spriting skills place to start!

There have been some excellent junker ship styles on the forums, and I thought to take a slightly different approach by focusing on the diversity of both fighting style and paintjob provided by the various Ork Clans in the setting, as a result this mod will be a bit more focused on bringing that aspect of Orky Kultur to the sector.

This is a Starsector mod first and foremost and I will not be strictly adhering to Battlefleet Gothic and 40k lore, and there will be some liberty in how I inject some proppa orkiness into the game, but I do hope you can find some good ol' orky fun within. This is our first starsector mod so any feedback and comment are appreciated as well. 😄
